scope: Observe the user-started first A40 render and compare with existing RTX 3090 runs; no additional benchmark generation submitted

confounds: A40 produces 80 frames at 16 fps in one section; RTX 3090 produces 120 frames at 24 fps in two sections
Natural comparison relighting strength changed from 1.0 to 1.25
Reference preparation bytes differ and conditioning videos are sampled at different fps
First A40 render on a fresh installation versus an already-used RTX 3090; CPU/RAM, power cap and cache state differ

similarWindowProxy.limitation: Comparable tensor/window size, not identical scene conditioning or cache state. Source frame count 80 is padded to 81 by SwapPrepareShot. This proxy does not prove same-settings hardware cost savings.

a40Telemetry.memoryInterpretation: The active snapshot uses more VRAM than a 24 GB card can hold. Reduced memory pressure is a plausible contributor; no profiler isolated the cause.

prior3090Observation.source: Read-only nvidia-smi output captured earlier in this conversation before the user destroyed the RTX 3090 instance

setupAndStorage.setupBillingLimit: Wall-clock rate conversion only; not an invoice. Actual billable setup time may differ during container loading. Runtime downloads add transfer costs.
setupAndStorage.storageDifferenceReason: Same per-GB listed rate, smaller 64 GB allocation versus 80 GB; not a GPU-family saving
setupAndStorage.paybackLimit: Conditional on accepting the lower-fps output and maintaining this observed saving; additional setup costs extend payback

decision.timeToResult: A40 configuration is substantially faster in this observation
decision.perRenderCost: About 23% lower at the actual differing settings
decision.hardwareOnlyCostEfficiency: Not proven better; similar-window section cost was slightly higher
decision.quality: Framing check passes, but 16 fps supplies fewer motion samples. No visual identity/acceptance score was measured.

billingMethod: Estimated render USD = measured client elapsed seconds / 3600 × saved running quote, including allocated storage during that interval. Excludes idle time, retained storage outside rendering, setup, bandwidth and taxes. No invoice reconciliation.
artifacts: Raw job snapshots, progress timestamps, A40 performance logs and pricing are retained only under ignored backups/a40-comparison-20261024/
